verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a dedicated Backlinks section grouping all incoming links at the bottom of each object. It also supports block-level linking and references across pages, and a graph view of note-to-note links. The docs do not mention [[wiki-style]] link syntax, unlinked-mention detection, or showing backlinks with surrounding context. Missing for 10: evidence of [[ ]] link syntax, unlinked mentions surfacing, in-context backlink snippets, independent corroboration.
